negative_constraints.reason: No real-user plugin installation or broad home access recommended/reported.
Process/sandbox labels explicitly separated from memory enforcement and per-memory/committed-memory scopes.
Exit or cancellation explicitly denied as proof of semantic artifact integrity or completed destination transfer.

source_families.family: declarative discovery and explicit converter formats
source_families.limits: Metadata is not authentication, isolation, semantic preset compatibility, or output-completeness proof.
A research analogy, not an export ABI or forced cancellation guarantee.
Interface typing/version information does not enforce runtime resources or saved-option semantics.

source_families.family: WASM memory limits and installation in Store
source_families.limits: Does not cover all host/runtime allocations or total RSS; multiple memories need aggregate accounting.
Guest execution budget is neither wall time nor a bound on blocking host calls/native components.
These are configured WASI-call rights, not arbitrary host-import/native process confinement. The shown API has no WriteOnly variant.

source_families.family: Linux process/resource hierarchy and aggregate overcommit
source_families.limits: Resource cgroups are not file-access authority, app admission order, guaranteed interactive latency, or storage-capacity quotas. Prevent migration out before relying on tree teardown.

source_families.family: Windows job membership, termination, memory and CPU
source_families.limits: Verify membership and explicit flags. Job Objects do not set file ACLs. CPU rate controls have Remote Desktop DFSS restrictions.
Actual identities, inherited handles, grants and compatibility must be selected/tested; no universal home isolation or memory quota follows from the label.
Archived deployment behavior needs version revalidation. Reviewed sources do not establish general converter CPU/memory quotas or descendant kill guarantees.
Signalling the original group cannot establish whole-descendant teardown. No synthetic escape was executed.
Not portable by default; configuration and coverage of all writable paths are required. Does not select a required filesystem or numeric quota.
No universal bundle atomicity, semantic output validity, destination persistence, or provider-specific transfer success follows.
It does not prevent path replacement, deletion, additional opens, or cross-job access under an unrestricted native identity.
Static code/tests reading supports actual mechanisms and regression context; tests were not run and no assertion of exhaustive defect detection is made.
